component.name: LGL Power Profile Manager
component.summary: Qt6 GUI for managing tuned power profiles

description.p: LGL Power Profile Manager is a desktop application for switching between tuned performance profiles on Fedora and RHEL-based systems. It runs as a normal user and uses pkexec to apply profiles with elevated privileges.

Features include a system tray icon that keeps the app running in the background, auto-refresh of the active profile every 5 seconds, a scrollable profile list with human-friendly labels and descriptions, a command output log, and a reference tab covering all built-in tuned profiles.

ul.li: Prevent multiple instances of the application from launching simultaneously.
Window close button now minimizes to system tray instead of quitting.
Right-click the tray icon to quit; left-click toggles the window.
System tray now shows the application icon.
